diagnostic_experiments.interpretation: This was an unpersisted local diagnostic variation, not a pinned qualification source. It shows that the obvious base-only route cannot currently provide an accepted trace in this fixture under the existing acceptance policy. Do not loosen tolerances; establish a supported accepted base FMR route or qualify explicit mobile/macropore solute exchange ownership before advancing E1. A 100x smaller requested interval did not resolve this fixture's rejection. Source inspection of pinned src/runtime/mod_fmr_serialized_reference_backend.f90 shows the base temporal evaluator returns huge() unless full and half states are exactly identical; the macro-disabled fixture's natural Richards difference is therefore always rejected. The macro path has a separate quantitative state-distance evaluator.
